idea-plugin.name: EU Data Act Switching Clause Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Reads your cloud contract text and names every clause Chapter VI no longer allows, with the article number and the wording that replaces it

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → EU Data Act Switching Clause Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 20 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/data-act-switching-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/data-act-switching-lint

action.text: EU Data Act Switching Clause Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run EU Data Act Switching Clause Lint on the file in the editor
